header.title: Stele des It (Äg. Slg. Tübingen Inv. Nr. 460): AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Stelae in Tübingen
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:egy:tla:tuebingerstelen:stele-des-it-ag-slg-tubingen-inv-nr-460:translit, from the Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae (2018), in Simon Schweitzer's AED-TEI (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.
header.availability: CC BY-SA 4.0, as its source requires: credit the Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae (2018), in Simon Schweitzer's AED-TEI and this AI translation, and share adaptations under the same licence.

notes.1.3: 1.6: ḥkꜣw taken as 'magician'; it may be some other title, and it is not clear whether Iku is the magician or the steward.

nodes.text: the royal sealer, deputy of the overseer of sealers, It, justified, born of the lady of the house Taau, justified;
the steward Hornakht the younger, justified, possessor of veneration;
the magician(?) of the steward, Iku, justified;
the lady of the house Nehyetni, justified;
the lady of the house Nebetiunet, justified.
